## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Documentation

Link the new `Documentation/Changes/` entry and affected guides for every repository
addition. For corrections only, link the existing entry or explain why no new
entry is needed. Link each new `Documentation/Gotchas/` page directly, or state
that no new gotchas were discovered.

## Planning

Record the task/scope ID and owning register, project item and native status,
schedule or blocker changes, and revision-bound exit evidence. Follow
`Documentation/Planning/AgentWorkflow.md`: set In Progress before starting and
Done only after the claimed exit is evidenced. Keep broader feature gaps open.

## Validation

List the checks performed and any checks still pending in CI.
